lines.en: Paulo, come and sit down. Mom told us the news this morning.

lines.en: What news? She told me nothing yesterday.

lines.en: Then why are you telling me in the living room?

lines.en: Because Mom told me the plan, and I could not wait.

lines.en: Then let’s tell Dad we will help him with the boxes.

lines.en: Good idea. I will tell Mom the news is great.

facts.label: Told + pessoa
facts.sub: Depois de told, coloque a pessoa: told me, told us, told her, told them. Depois, diga a notícia: She told us the news. Não use said me.

facts.label: Contar a alguém
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa: She told us the news. He told me a story. They told her the truth. A pessoa vem logo depois de told, sem to.

facts.label: Cuidado com said
facts.sub: Said e told são parecidos, mas said não leva pessoa direto. Diga She said that she was happy. Diga She told me that she was happy. Said to me existe, mas é menos comum.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Told is followed by a person.
We say “She said us the news.”
items.why: We say She told us the news.

items.s: We can say “She told them a story.”

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Told is followed by a person. → Verdadeiro (Yes: told me, told us.)
We say “She said us the news.” → Falso (We say She told us the news.)
We can say “She told them a story.” → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A family evening · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold Sunday evening in a living room in Chicago. A warm lamp shines on the old sofa. Gil sits with a cup of tea. His brother Paulo comes home late. Their mother is in the kitchen. Gil has some big news to share.
“Paulo, come and sit down. Mom told us the news this morning.” says Gil. “What news? She told me nothing yesterday.” says Paulo. “She told us Grandma was coming to live with us next month.” says Gil.
